senses.gloss: m. (v. כַּוָּוא; cmp. חוֹפֶן a. כַּף) the hollow of the hand, handful (as a measure), spoonful (mostly in medicine; cmp. Lat. coclear). [Editions, except ed. Sonc., have ב׳, Ar. a. Mss. כ׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. c. infra.] Sabb. 110ᵇ כ׳ דכמונא וכ׳ (Ms. M. כי׳) one handful of cumin-seed, and one of &c.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 70a">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ דחמרא וכ׳</he> a spoonful of old wine.—Pl. <he>כַּוְנֵי</he> or <he>כּוּנֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Eruvin 29b">Erub. 29ᵇ</cite> (ed. Sonc. <he>כַּוְונֵי</he>, v. Rabb. R. S. a. l. note).
